# IMinimalVestingWallet
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/gov-contracts/src/interfaces/IMinimalVestingWallet.sol)

**Title:**
IMinimalVestingWallet

Minimal vesting wallet interface exposing the subset of the vesting wallet used by the escrow


## Functions
### balanceOf

Returns the vesting wallet's balance of staked tokens for an account

the balance of the vesting wallet can only go down - if it goes up - tokens were sent to the wallet
(unintended bhavior) @param _user The address to query the balance for


```solidity
function balanceOf(address _user) external view returns (uint256);
```
**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`uint256`|The staked balance held by the wallet for the account|


### owner

Returns the current owner of the vesting wallet

the current owner of the vesting wallet ( might be different that owner in the factory contract)


```solidity
function owner() external view returns (address);
```
**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`address`|The address of the current wallet owner|


### transferOwnership

Transfers ownership of the vesting wallet to a new owner

the ownership of the vesting wallet can be trnsfered - this is used to transfer the ownership of the
vesting wallet to the user @param newOwner The address of the new owner


```solidity
function transferOwnership(address newOwner) external;
```

### released

Returns the amount of a given token already released from the vesting wallet

the amount of tokens released from the vesting wallet


```solidity
function released(address _token) external view returns (uint256);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`_token`|`address`|The token whose released amount is queried|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`uint256`|The amount of the token already released|
